title: Watching in step
description: Serves "Watching together works."; "They see only what they may.".
acceptanceCriteria: Two viewers on different api replicas stay in step in Octave (or, until JS-190 and JS-150, the native browser check): play, pause, seek and buffering.
No one in a group sees or is offered what they could not see alone, and each keeps their own place in the title.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
